messages:
maya: heads up — AsterID reported odd tokenization + answer truncation after we merged their LoRA onto `redwood/llamax-13b`.
sam: saw the alert. can you paste an example?
maya: from customer convo: `Input: 'User: show my last 5 transactions'` -> model returns partial json then drops to ``ERROR: \ufffd``
lee: maybe a tokenizer boundary shift from the adapter weights? happened before with nonstandard punctuation.
irene: quick data: the adapter was trained with sentencepiece v1.2 vs base model using spm v1.0. that mismatch could shift token IDs.
maya: hmm that explains poor merges earlier. eval-bot, can you run quickpack on the merged artifact (int8, int4) across 200 queries focusing on transactional prompts?
eval-bot: queued quickpack: asterid-merge-check-2026-03-20. running 200 prompts, metrics: token-split-rate, response-latency, sequence-drop-rate.
dev-bot: canary deploy for asterid-merge v2 started on dedicated pool `ded-nyc-2`.
sam: results: int8 looks ok for tokenization (split-rate 1.2%), int4 shows 8.9% split anomalies and a 12% higher sequence-drop.
lee: that matches token-id drift hypothesis. any difference in tokenizer vocab size reported during merge?
maya: adapter pipeline logged `vocab_size: 50000` vs base `vocab_size: 50256` — small but could remap ids when merging.
irene: proposed fix: re-run Merge with tokenizer-alignment step: map adapter token ids to base tokenizer using alignment map + remap weights for embedding rows. it's lightweight.
niko: quick command I'd run:
```
python tools/adapter_merge.py \
  --base redwood/llamax-13b \
  --adapter asterid-paying-lora-v3 \
  --align-tokenizer --align-method=soft-map \
  --out merged/asterid-llama-aligned-v1
```
lee: good. also run fast-regression suite `tests/uitrans_action_set` and look for JSON truncation.
sam: dev-bot, pause the canary until aligned build passes.
dev-bot: canary paused by @sam. awaiting new artifact.
maya: also add a small smoke that checks for unpaired open braces in JSON responses — we keep seeing `{
  "tx": [` then abrupt end.
irene: will add that to quickpack as `json-complete-check`.
eval-bot: new quickpack run scheduled after artifact upload. expecting ~10m runtime.
maya: thanks — if aligned merge fixes token split we can push to dedicated. otherwise rollback to previous commit (tag `asterid-prev-20260318`).
sam: logging follow-up tasks in Jira: AsterID-1324 tokenizer-align, AsterID-1325 merge-smoke, AsterID-1326 rollback-docs.
lee: fyi add note to onboarding doc about adapter tokenizer versions — avoid training adapters with mismatched tokenizers unless explicit remapping.
maya: perfect. I'll take the merge and run locally, will post the aligned artifact here when done. :thumbsup:
maya: (later) uploaded merged/asterid-llama-aligned-v1 to s3://redwood-builds/asterid/ — starting quickpack now.
eval-bot: quickpack complete. metrics: int4 split anomalies 1.6%, sequence-drop 1.1%, json-truncations 0.5% (baseline 0.4%). int8: split 0.9%, drop 0.3%.
maya: looks acceptable. canary resume?
sam: resume approved. dev-bot: resume canary for asterid-merge v2.
dev-bot: canary resumed — rollout to 10%.
lee: monitor the `response-json-completeness` dashboard for next 2 hours.
maya: thanks team. saving notes: adapter-tokenizer-align step should be added to `eng-ml/onboarding-checklist.md` and into the `adapter_merge` tool as `--align-tokenizer` by default for customer adapters.
